verdicts.quote: Promotion is automatic, with no accept/decline step.
entries are served strictly in join order. […] two joins at the same instant get distinct join orders (no tie) […] store a monotonically increasing join order per session
joining several overlapping classes' waitlists is allowed only to the extent the app already allows booking overlapping classes […] every existing eligibility, credit/payment, overlap and cutoff rule
verdicts.missing: The spec leaves open whether promotion into one class immediately ends the overlapping entry or leaves it waiting for its own eligibility check.

verdicts.quote: Promotion is automatic, with no accept/decline step. […] a promoted member who cannot attend must cancel through the existing cancel flow (late-cancel rules apply as today).
verdicts.missing: Late cancellation is addressed, but the spec does not explicitly say whether missing an automatic promotion and failing to attend counts as a no-show.

verdicts.quote: the first eligible entry in join order is turned into a real booking, in the same atomic operation that freed the seat. Triggers: member cancels their booking

one notification through the app's existing notification channel (G-3), stating the class, its time and the outcome. […] channel returns an error → booking and entry stay Promoted, the failure is logged
two simultaneous cancellations free two seats (capacity 2, booked [Ana, Ben], waiting [Cara, Dev, Eli]) → exactly Cara and Dev promoted, Eli position 1; no one promoted twice.
a member with a Waiting entry who books directly gets ON_WAITLIST; entry unchanged. […] seat release + mark Promoted + create booking in ONE atomic unit
the waitlist takes no payment […] Cara's entry becomes Ineligible, Dev (next) is evaluated for the same seat […] Concrete E-4/E-5 triggers and charge behaviour **unready**
verdicts.missing: The spec defers when a promoted booking is charged and whether a failed charge skips the member as ineligible or rolls back the promotion as a booking-creation failure.

verdicts.quote: a waitlist length cap (G-5, default none)

When the class is no longer bookable under the app's existing rule (started or past cutoff), no join and no promotion happens […] the instant of the cutoff follows the app's existing booking rule exactly
staff sets capacity 4 → Cara and Dev promoted in that order […] capacity 4 → 3 with booked 4 (staff cut): no booking is removed; Ana cancels → booked 3 = capacity 3, no promotion
when the studio cancels a class, every Waiting entry becomes Closed and the member is told
Waitlist entry (member, session, join order, state, link to booking) […] store a monotonically increasing join order per session; position = 1 + count of Waiting entries with a smaller order.
verdicts.missing: The record stores join order, but the spec leaves open whether it also records the time the member joined.

verdicts.quote: Dev still Waiting but not promoted […] Retention of terminal entries follows existing booking-record retention until G-7 is decided.
verdicts.missing: Entries can still be Waiting after the class runs. The spec gives a retention rule only for terminal entries, leaving the cleanup time for these Waiting entries undecided.

verdicts.quote: A member sees their own position; they never see who else is queued.
applies only if the app already has a staff/admin role […] a staff member opens S1 and sees the ordered waiting members with their join order and can remove one entry
verdicts.missing: The staff controls cover viewing and removal. The spec gives staff no manual promotion action and does not specify a staff-visible history showing who was promoted and when.

verdicts.quote: the first eligible entry in join order is turned into a real booking, in the same atomic operation that freed the seat.
a class with free seats and no queue is booked and cancelled exactly as before. […] unrelated bookings are untouched.
No migration of existing data is needed: entries start empty. […] a signed-in member viewing a full, bookable class can join its waitlist
